# Verdict grid: fixtures by candidates

<!-- generated by report/make_docs.py from fixtures/crs.json and results/results.jsonl; do not edit -->

Each cell compares the candidate with PROJ on that fixture. Fixture ids link to their pages ([catalog](../fixtures/FIXTURES.md)); candidates are described in [harness/README.md](../harness/README.md#candidates); layer-by-layer reading in [capability-matrix.md](../capability-matrix.md).

| verdict | meaning |
|---|---|
| exact | exact: within 1 mm of PROJ |
| close | close: within 1 m of PROJ |
| OFF | off: 1 m or more from PROJ (distance shown) |
| SWAP | axis-swapped: matches PROJ with the axes swapped |
| fail | failed: both CRSs resolved but no finite result |
| -- | unresolved: could not build one of the CRSs from the input |
| n/a | n/a: the input does not apply to this candidate (crs-definitions takes authority codes only) |
| refuse | refused-like-oracle: PROJ refused this fixture and so did the candidate |
| ANSWER | answered-where-oracle-refused: PROJ refused but the candidate returned a value |
